# Step - element

`element` · category: [Values and properties](../../traversal/step_reference.md#values-and-properties)

Moves from a property to the vertex or edge that owns it.

## Forms

```text
element()
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v(1).properties("name").element().values("age").next()   // 29
```
